fichas.title: Energy Pass and Building Energy Performance
fichas.summary: Explains the energy pass required under the Energy Saving Regulation (EnEV), the distinction between primary energy demand, final energy demand, and energy consumption, and the use of graphic comparisons to communicate a building’s energy performance. The figures show producer energy-price development, an example annual energy-demand comparison, and a sample residential energy pass. Calculated values use standardized conditions and do not predict actual consumption; energy consumption values are based on heating and hot-water costs and adjusted for climate. Energy passes may include modernization recommendations.
uses: Document and compare building energy demand or consumption
Communicate energy efficiency and support building marketing, investment, and purchase or rental decisions
